about: Red-team set for the deterministic guard (src/lib/guard.ts). Written by hand on 11 Oct 2026, after the guard, as sentences a model might plausibly write for the three demo plans; scored once by scripts/evaluate.mts and published as-is (the guard was not changed to fit this set). 'withhold' = the guard should withhold it; 'keep' = ordinary, supportable plan text that should pass. Each case is checked against its demo plan's own facts (route, ranks, hotspots, rooms, capacity).
